Title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Global Submarine Networks Landing Stations Build
Description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Reston, VA, USA; New York, NY, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program management.
* 8 years of experience in engineering design, technical program management, or infrastructure delivery focused on Cable Landing Stations (CLS), hyperscale data centers, or telecommunications facilities.
* 5 years of experience in leadership role with/without direct reports.
* 5 years of experience with submarine cable system landing infrastructure, including experience with beach manholes (BMH), terrestrial front-haul duct routes, Ocean Ground Bed (OGB) earthing systems, and Power Feed Equipment (PFE) room requirements.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Infrastructure Management, accompanied by an active Professional Engineer (PE), Chartered Engineer (CEng), or equivalent international engineering licensure.
* Experience in bidding, designing, operating, and commissioning of mission critical systems.
* Expertise navigating coastal zoning, nearshore geophysical hazards, seismicity, flood resilience, environmental impact assessments (EIA), and marine permit constraints impacting landing station design.
* Strong background in technical due diligence, utility infrastructure assessments, vendor contract negotiations, and managing multi-million-dollar capital expenditure budgets (CapEx) alongside operating budgets (OpEx).

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Direct, mentor, and grow a multi-disciplinary team of global engineering SMEs and technical program managers responsible for land due diligence, facility engineering, and construction delivery.
* Establish and manage design frameworks, quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) protocols, stage gate project execution procedures, and programmatic delivery standards for Cable Landing Stations globally.
* Manage portfolio of technical due diligence evaluations on greenfield land parcels and existing facility assets worldwide, evaluating civil, geotechnical, environmental, power, and marine approach suitability for new landing stations.
* Evaluate design delivery models in conjunction with construction execution and contracting methodologies to derisk project delivery and accelerate portfolio execution while maintaining design quality assurance.
* Lead teams responsible for technical field administration during construction execution, including managing Requests for Information (RFIs), submittal reviews, design field changes, and construction quality inspections.

Title: Service Management (MSP Governance & ITIL Operations Lead)
Description:
IT Service Management Manager

**MSP Governance | ITIL Operations | Major Incident Management**

**Reports to:**
Director, Technology & Security Operations

**Location:**
Toronto, Ontario (Hybrid – 2 days in-office)

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced IT Service Management Manager to lead Managed Service Provider (MSP) governance, ITSM operations, vendor performance management and continuous service improvement across the enterprise.

This role is accountable for ensuring reliable, high-quality technology services through effective vendor oversight, structured service governance, incident management and operational performance monitoring.

The successful candidate will bring approximately 15 years of overall IT Service Management experience, including at least 5 years in a Service Management Manager or equivalent leadership capacity. They will have the experience and confidence to manage external service providers, establish accountability, oversee service delivery and work effectively with senior technology stakeholders.

Equally important is the ability to adapt to changing business priorities and evolving technology requirements. We are looking for someone who combines strong management experience with a practical, collaborative and hands-on approach.

This is not a traditional service desk management role. It is a governance-focused position requiring strong MSP oversight, vendor accountability, ITIL process management, major incident leadership and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

1. MSP Governance & Vendor Management

* Own and oversee the performance of third-party Managed Service Providers across enterprise IT services.
* Manage vendor performance against contractual obligations, SLAs, KPIs, availability targets, response and resolution times.
* Establish and maintain vendor governance frameworks, performance scorecards, escalation procedures and accountability models.
* Lead monthly and quarterly service reviews with MSPs, identifying service gaps and driving corrective action plans.
* Hold service providers accountable for performance issues, recurring incidents and contractual commitments.
* Build strong relationships with internal technology teams, procurement, business stakeholders and external service providers.
* Identify opportunities to improve vendor performance, service quality, operational efficiency and value for money.

2. IT Service Management & ITIL Governance

* Govern and continuously improve enterprise ITSM processes in alignment with ITIL best practices.
* Oversee Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Asset, Knowledge and Technology Continuity Management.
* Ensure ITSM processes are consistently followed by MSPs and internal technology teams.
* Monitor ticket quality, backlog aging, incident trends, reassignment rates and overall service management effectiveness.
* Establish clear process ownership, RACI frameworks and escalation models.
* Partner with technology leadership to establish meaningful service management KPIs and performance measures.
* Conduct ITSM maturity assessments and identify opportunities to strengthen governance, processes and operational capabilities.

3. Major Incident & Problem Management

* Lead and coordinate Priority 1 and Priority 2 technology incidents, acting as Incident Commander when required.
* Coordinate incident response activities, including war rooms, escalations, stakeholder communications and executive updates.
* Ensure incidents are managed within established response and resolution targets.
* Facilitate Post-Incident Reviews and validate Root Cause Analysis reports provided by service providers.
* Track corrective and preventative actions to minimize recurring incidents.
* Identify systemic service issues and work with vendors to implement sustainable improvements.

4. Change Management & Operational Risk

* Participate in and serve as an approver for the Change Advisory Board (CAB).
* Evaluate proposed changes based on business impact, operational risk, testing, implementation readiness and rollback plans.
* Ensure appropriate change management controls and governance practices are followed.
* Monitor change success rates, unauthorized changes and incidents resulting from production changes.
* Work with technology teams and service providers to minimize operational disruption during technology changes and implementations.

5. Service Performance & Continuous Improvement

* Develop and maintain service performance dashboards and executive-level reporting.
* Translate service management metrics, including MTTR, availability, incident trends, backlog health and change success rates, into meaningful operational and business insights.
* Identify opportunities to improve service delivery, reduce recurring incidents, minimize downtime and enhance the end-user experience.
* Lead continuous service improvement initiatives aligned with organizational priorities.
* Recommend process improvements, automation opportunities and enhancements to service delivery models.
* Partner with senior technology leadership to improve transparency, operational accountability and service performance.

6. ITSM Transformation & Technology Enablement

* Identify opportunities to modernize IT service management through workflow automation, improved self-service capabilities and emerging technologies.
* Support enhancements to ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms.
* Explore AI-enabled ITSM capabilities to improve incident management, knowledge management, service request handling and operational efficiency.
* Work collaboratively with internal teams and service providers to implement practical improvements.
* Adapt service management practices as technology, business requirements and organizational priorities evolve.

7. Disaster Recovery & Technology Continuity

* Support governance and oversight of Disaster Recovery planning and testing activities.
* Validate operational readiness and ensure appropriate continuity procedures are documented and maintained.
* Confirm Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) are aligned with business requirements.
* Ensure continuity runbooks and recovery procedures are tested and validated before high-risk technology initiatives or changes.

Required Experience & Qualifications

* Approximately 15 years of overall experience in IT Service Management, IT Service Delivery or IT Operations.
* **Minimum 5 years of experience specifically in a Service Management Manager**
  or equivalent leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience managing and governing third-party Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and technology service vendors.
* Strong understanding of vendor performance management, contractual obligations, SLAs, KPIs, service delivery and escalation management.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL frameworks, preferably ITIL v4, with practical experience overseeing Incident, Problem and Change Management.
* Demonstrated experience managing major technology incidents, including P1/P2 incident coordination and escalation.
* Experience participating in or leading Change Advisory Boards (CAB) and assessing operational and business risks.
* Proven ability to identify service delivery gaps, challenge vendor performance and implement corrective action plans.
* Experience developing service performance reports, dashboards and operational KPIs for technology leadership.
* Experience conducting ITSM process assessments, identifying improvement opportunities and supporting service transformation initiatives.
* Experience with ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms, including incident workflows, reporting, automation and self-service capabilities.
* Experience supporting hybrid technology environments, including Microsoft 365, Google Cloud Platform and third-party SaaS platforms.
* Experience supporting Disaster Recovery planning, testing and operational readiness activities.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications & Assets

* ITIL v4 Foundation or higher certification.
* Experience working in a complex enterprise technology environment.
* Experience overseeing multiple MSPs or service providers across different technology domains.
* Familiarity with ITSM automation, AI-enabled service management and workflow optimization.
* Experience with service governance frameworks, operational risk management and continuous improvement methodologies.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be an established IT Service Management leader with approximately 15 years of overall ITSM experience and at least 5 years managing service management functions.

They will have the experience to independently manage external service providers, challenge vendor performance, drive accountability and communicate effectively with senior technology stakeholders.

Description:
**Job Description**
**What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?**

The Infrastructure Digital Delivery Lead is the strategic technology architect responsible for the comprehensive digital lifecycle of our major infrastructure, utility corridors, bridges, and infrastructure master plans. Operating across the entire delivery continuum from conceptual design to asset handover this role unifies BIM, Geospatial Intelligence (GIS), Real-time Digital Twins, Legacy CAD standardizations, High-End 3D Visualizations, and AI-driven workflow automations.
  
  
You will not just manage models; you will design the overarching data infrastructure that connects engineering design to operational asset management, ensuring absolute data integrity, efficiency, and future-proof project delivery.

**Key Responsibilities & Duties**

* Digital Strategy, Frameworks & BIM Governance
* Author, maintain, and enforce the overarching Digital Delivery Execution Plan (DDEP) and BIM Execution Plans (BEP) in strict compliance with ISO 19650 standards.
* Establish, structure, and administer the Common Data Environment (CDE) using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360, setting up automated review workflows, ISO container compliance, and multi-firm security access permissions.
* Govern project coordinate systems, ensuring zero spatial or coordinate drift across linear highway alignments, utility networks, structural bridges, and global GIS maps.
* GIS & Digital Twin Integration
* Architect the bidirectional data pipelines connecting GIS platforms (Esri ArcGIS / QGIS) with horizontal engineering design software (Civil 3D / OpenRoads).
* Build the schema maps and asset metadata frameworks required to translate 3D BIM data into operational Digital Twin environments (e.g., Autodesk Tandem, Bentley iTwin, or custom web-based twin environments).
* Define asset tracking protocols to integrate future IoT sensor data metadata placeholders within the smart-city asset master list during the design phase.
* CAD Legacy & Hybrid Workflows
* Maintain strict quality control over traditional, two-dimensional deliverables by enforcing uniform CAD standards (layer structures, plot styles, sheet sets) alongside 3D environments.
* Manage hybrid workflows ensuring that legacy 2D drawings dynamically update from the core 3D federated model, minimizing manual drafting errors.
* 3D Visualization & Reality Capture
* Manage large-scale visual aggregation models within Autodesk InfraWorks, Twinmotion, or Unreal Engine to produce high-end, real-time interactive models for public consultation and executive stakeholder reviews.
* Oversite the integration of Reality Capture datasets (UAV Photogrammetry, LiDAR point clouds, mobile scanning) into active design environments for real-time site verification.
* AI Tools, Scripting & Automations
* Develop, scale, and deploy custom automations using Dynamo for Civil 3D/Revit, Python, or VBA to eliminate repetitive drafting tasks, automate grading calculations, and auto-populate asset metadata fields.
* Implement AI-driven design tools and generative design algorithms for optimizing massive earthworks volumes, alternative highway corridor alignments, and automated clash resolution pipelines.
* Utilize AI text and data analytics tools to run predictive automated audits on thousands of model parameters, catching quality drops instantly.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Information Management, Digital Engineering, or related discipline.
* Master's Degree would be advantageous
* Minimum 15 years of professional experience.
* Proven experience leading digital delivery on large-scale transport and infrastructure projects.
* Strong background supporting the design and delivery of:

+ Roads & Highways
+ Rail & Transit
+ Bridges and Structures
+ Utilities
+ Aviation
+ Smart Infrastructure Projects

* Demonstrated success in implementing BIM and digital transformation strategies within engineering consultancies.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary digital delivery teams.
* Experience working in the UAE and/or wider Middle East strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 19650 standards.

**Technical Proficiencies:**

* BIM / Civil Design: Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Civil 3D (corridors, pipes, gradings), InfraWorks, and Revit (structures/bridges).
* Geospatial (GIS): Expert capability in Esri ArcGIS (Pro / Online) and its native integrations with the Autodesk ecosystem.
* Digital Twin & Visualization: Practical understanding of Digital Twin schemas (Asset Information Models) and real-time rendering environments (InfraWorks, Enscape, Twinmotion).
* Automation & Coding: Proficient with Dynamo, Python, or visual programming tools. Experience with AI prompt engineering or AI plugins for design optimization is highly valued.
* Collaboration & CAD: Mastery of Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) alongside classic AutoCAD Architecture/Civil workflows.

Title: Cloud Infrastructure Manager
Description:
Cloud Infrastructure Manager
  
**The role**

Lead the cloud infrastructure that runs myZoi’s production platforms across AWS and Azure, keeping them reliable, secure, scalable and cost-effective.

This is a player-coach role. You will manage the DevOps and SRE team while staying hands-on in design, implementation and incident response, with particular depth in cloud and infrastructure networking.

You will own the infrastructure roadmap, operational performance and delivery of improvements. You will work closely with Architecture, Engineering, Cybersecurity and Technology Operations to support business growth and maintain service continuity.

Key responsibilities
  
  
Team leadership
  
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop the DevOps and SRE team; set clear objectives and manage performance.
* Plan priorities across operational work, improvements and projects, with clear owners, milestones and escalation of risks.
* Build on-call arrangements, backup coverage and knowledge sharing so no service depends on a single engineer; take part in the escalation rota.
* Report proactively on service health, delivery progress, costs and material risks.

Hands-on infrastructure and networking
  
  
  

* Design, build and operate cloud networking across AWS and Azure, including VPC/VNet design, hub-and-spoke or transit topologies, routing, DNS, load balancing, private endpoints and hybrid connectivity (VPN, AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute).
* Implement network security controls, including segmentation, firewalls, security groups and NSGs, WAF and secure ingress and egress.
* Build and operate compute, storage, managed databases and Kubernetes platforms, with clear segregation of production and non-production environments.
* Write and review Terraform, and set standards for configuration management, patching and lifecycle management using version control, peer review and automated checks.
* Develop infrastructure designs with Architecture and implement the agreed standards.
* Lead the technical planning and execution of migrations and infrastructure transitions, including testing, cutover, rollback and handover.

DevOps and reliability
  
  
  

* Oversee infrastructure automation, deployment tooling and CI/CD in partnership with Engineering.
* Improve monitoring, observability and actionable alerting; agree service-level objectives with service owners.
* Own infrastructure-level escalation and restoration during incidents, then drive root-cause analysis and lasting fixes.
* Maintain capacity and performance plans aligned with expected demand.

Backup and disaster recovery
  
  
  

* Own infrastructure backup, restore and recovery mechanisms.
* Plan and run recovery tests with Technology Operations and application owners, validating agreed RTO and RPO targets.

Security and compliance
  
  
  

* Implement cloud security controls in line with Cybersecurity policies, including identity and privileged access, encryption, logging and secrets management.
* Ensure vulnerabilities and configuration weaknesses are remediated within agreed timelines.
* Apply regulatory, data-residency and contractual requirements to infrastructure, with guidance from the responsible functions.
* Maintain current infrastructure documentation, recovery procedures and auditable records of access, changes, control operation and test results; support internal and external reviews.

Cost and supplier management
  
  
  

* Manage cloud spend within approved budgets, with transparent allocation, forecasting and reporting.
* Drive cost optimisation through rightsizing, commitment-based purchasing and removal of unused resources.
* Manage the technical performance of cloud and infrastructure suppliers, supporting commercial decisions with Finance and Procurement.

Experience and capabilities
  

* Typically 8 or more years in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps or related disciplines, including at least 3 years managing engineers.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams that run business-critical production services, while remaining hands-on.
* Strong hands-on experience with both AWS and Azure. Experience with cross-cloud migration is advantageous.
* Deep networking expertise across cloud and hybrid environments: TCP/IP, routing, subnetting, DNS, load balancing, VPN and private connectivity, firewalls and segmentation, and troubleshooting complex connectivity issues.
* Practical expertise in identity and access management, Terraform, Kubernetes, CI/CD and observability.
* Experience with disaster recovery testing, major incidents, infrastructure security and cost optimisation.
* Ability to challenge technical proposals, prioritise competing demands and explain decisions in clear business terms.
* Proven delivery through internal teams and external suppliers, with effective delegation and proactive escalation.
* Financial-services, payments or other regulated-sector experience is preferred.

Qualifications
  

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Relevant AWS, Azure, Terraform or Kubernetes certifications are desirable.
* Networking certifications (for example AWS Advanced Networking, Azure Network Engineer Associate or CCNP) are a plus.
* Familiarity with ITIL and recognised security frameworks is advantageous.

* Proven experience designing and operating infrastructure to meet 24/7 availability, redundancy, and disaster recovery requirements.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing or coordinating multi-disciplinary operations (network + security) and reporting outcomes to leadership.
* Strong skills in preparing operational reports, dashboards, and presentations for leadership and stakeholder audiences.
* Proven track record running operational meetings and driving structured escalation handling to resolution.
* Hands-on experience managing major changes, including change planning, risk assessment, CAB processes, and post-implementation review.
* Hands-on expertise with enterprise routers, switches, firewalls, NVAs, and cloud-native network security monitoring tools.
* Experience hardening network and cloud infrastructure against security frameworks and remediating audit findings.
* Strong troubleshooting and incident-response experience across routing, switching, cloud networking, and security domains.
* Excellent coordination and communication skills, with the ability to work closely with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Title: Network Security Lead - Cloud Infrastructure
Description:
**Network Security Lead - Cloud Infrastructure**

Own the end-to-end architecture, design, deployment, and 24/7 operational management of secure network and security infrastructure across cloud (Azure, GCP, OCI) and on-premises environments — spanning routing, switching, and cybersecurity engineering. Act as the technical authority responsible for designing highly available, resilient architectures; leading deployment and configuration of new environments; and operating the infrastructure around the clock to ensure it remains stable, secure, and audit-ready. Skilled in preparing operational reports and presentations, running operational meetings, handling escalations, and managing major changes — while retaining hands-on accountability for daily operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design secure reference architectures for hub-spoke topologies, VNet/VPC/VCN environments, subnetting, IP/CIDR planning, and static/BGP dynamic routing across Azure, GCP, and OCI, as well as on-prem routing and switching infrastructure.
* Architect secure connectivity patterns — VPN, peering, and dedicated interconnects (ExpressRoute, Interconnect, FastConnect) — and lead network security design reviews with actionable, best-practice recommendations.
* Lead deployment and configuration of network security environments: Site-to-Site VPNs with redundant tunnels and BGP routing, VPC/VCN peering, NSGs, security lists/ACLs, NVAs, next-gen firewalls, and Internet/NAT/Service Gateways for new builds and migrations.
* Design, deploy, and operate infrastructure to meet 24/7 availability targets, including redundancy, failover, load balancing, and disaster recovery across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Own round-the-clock operational management of the network and security environment: change management, patching/upgrades of NVAs, vulnerability tracking and remediation, and coordination of patch windows and incident response.
* Manage and oversee day-to-day network and security operations across routing, switching, and cybersecurity engineering, keeping leadership informed of status, risks, and escalations.
* Configure and maintain monitoring, logging, and diagnostics (Azure Monitor, GCP Cloud Monitoring, OCI Monitoring, flow logs) to proactively detect and resolve availability, performance, and security issues.
* Harden network device and cloud configurations against industry benchmarks (e.g., CIS, NIST) and internal security baselines; remediate findings from internal/external audits.
* Prepare and present operational reports, dashboards, and presentations summarizing network/security performance, availability, incidents, and risk posture to leadership and stakeholders.
* Plan and run operational meetings — daily/weekly stand-ups, service reviews, and incident review sessions — driving action items to closure.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical operational and security issues across all managed platforms, ensuring timely resolution and clear communication.
* Own and handle major changes end-to-end — planning, risk assessment, change advisory board (CAB) submissions, implementation, and post-change validation — with minimal impact to 24/7 availability.
* Design, deploy, and validate backup and restore procedures for NVAs, firewall policies, and network configuration state; own disaster recovery and cross-region DR networking design.
* Coordinate cross-functional activities with cloud, security, application, and operations teams to ensure consistent security posture and always-on availability across the environment.
* Maintain accurate architecture documentation, network diagrams, runbooks, and operational procedures; ensure changes follow proper governance, risk, and change-control processes.
* Mentor engineers and act as a point of technical escalation for complex operational or security issues.
* Participate in an on-call rotation and respond to critical incidents outside business hours to maintain 24/7 availability; travel to datacenter or client sites as needed.

**Required Certifications**

* Cisco CCNP (Enterprise / Security) or equivalent vendor-neutral routing & switching certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Security Engineer Associate (or Azure Solutions Architect Expert).
* Google Professional Cloud Network Engineer / Cloud Security Engineer.
* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Network Security Professional or Architect Professional.
* CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) or working toward certification.
* Firewall/NGFW vendor certification (e.g., Palo Alto PCNSA/PCNSE, Fortinet NSE, or Check Point CCSA/CCSE).

*Preferred: CCIE, CISM, CEH. At least two of Azure, GCP, and OCI required; all three strongly preferred. Certifications must be current; equivalent recognized credentials considered subject to approval.*

**Experience Required**

* 10–15 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, network operations, and cybersecurity engineering, including hands-on ownership of designing, deploying, and operating secure network infrastructure.
* Demonstrable depth across at least two of Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (all three strongly preferred).
* Proven experience designing and operating infrastructure to meet 24/7 availability, redundancy, and disaster recovery requirements.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing or coordinating multi-disciplinary operations (network + security) and reporting outcomes to leadership.
* Strong skills in preparing operational reports, dashboards, and presentations for leadership and stakeholder audiences.
* Proven track record running operational meetings and driving structured escalation handling to resolution.
* Hands-on experience managing major changes, including change planning, risk assessment, CAB processes, and post-implementation review.
* Hands-on expertise with enterprise routers, switches, firewalls, NVAs, and cloud-native network security monitoring tools.
* Experience hardening network and cloud infrastructure against security frameworks and remediating audit findings.
* Strong troubleshooting and incident-response experience across routing, switching, cloud networking, and security domains.

---------------

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Join this highly visible team in a highly visible role.
  
  
The ATL Cluster is a fast growing region with many growth opportunities. Don't hesitate to reach out about this highly impactful, highly visible role.
  
  
The Infrastructure Operations organization is looking for an extraordinary individual with proven and tested leadership and management skills as a leader in our facilities operations organization in Atlanta as a Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Cluster Manager.  
  
DCEO Cluster Manager is one of our most senior management roles in Atlanta. In this role, you will be responsible for leading a large organization, managing Area Managers and/or Facility Managers who own data center facility infrastructure. In other words, DCEO Cluster Manager is ultimately in charge of managing multiple data centers.  
The pace, scale, and growth of Amazon’s data center platform will challenge you. Our uncompromisingly high standards as we continually seek to innovate on behalf of our customers will push you to new levels of creativity. At this level Amazon is unique in that we seek experienced senior leaders who have evolved to be highly strategic in their approach to managing their business unit, yet understand how to lead large teams by example who will not hesitate to roll up their sleeves when tactical needs dictate it.  
  
The ideal candidate for this role will have a strong understanding in data center/mission critical MEP infrastructure. You will be the single point of the contact for all facility related issues from Atlanta team and work as the technical resource to support Regional Cluster Manager. You will solely be responsible for maintaining 100% service uptime in your Cluster. You have a very high-level view of your organization but you will need to deep dive into details as needed. You will also be interacting with global team on a daily basis by representing Atlanta Data Center Engineering Operations team.  
  
If you are passionate about the Customer Experience, think and act globally and want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon.com data centers. This may be the challenge you’ve been looking for!  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Hiring, managing, and developing the operations management team including facility managers, area managers, chief engineers, facility technicians.
* Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility operations and maintenance
* Responsible for the on-site management of shift technicians, senior shift technicians, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices and procedures.
* Build and maintain sustainable organizational structure.
* Work with business development, real estate, engineering and construction team to forecast staffing and maintain.
* Mentor and develop employees.
* Hiring strategy and participation in recruiting events.
* Operation and maintenance of mechanical, electrical, and controls systems for Amazon data centers to include preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, and change management.
* Manage all facility related repairs in a timely manner
* Daily/weekly/monthly/Data Center Engineering Operations meetings and reporting.
* Run weekly availability meeting and report outcomes.
* Liaise with global team on global initiatives as well as process and procedures, implement those initiatives locally in Atlanta.
* Vendor management of colocation data center services providers to meet or exceed contracted performance SLA’s.
* Safety, security, and availability incident response, incident management, incident resolution, and root cause analysis.
* Cost management including OPEX and CAPEX associated with all data centers you are in charge.
* Continuous improvement of operational processes, procedures, methods, and tools.
* Lead and manage energy efficiency initiatives in your Cluster.
* Support capacity planning and management

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience hiring, developing, and managing high-performing technical teams
* 5+ years of managing managers experience
* 10+ years of mission critical facilities experience
* Knowledge of the electrical and mechanical systems involved in critical data center operations including systems such as feeders, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, ATS units, PDU units, chillers, pumps, air handling units, and CRAC units

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with process improvement techniques such as Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma
* Experience with large-scale technical operations or large-scale compute farms
* Knowledge of information technology infrastructure domains such as compute server platforms, storage server platforms, server components, network devices, technologies and architectures, IT service delivery principles and best practices
* Mission Critical facility management experience for a large enterprise or large Colocation provider

Title: System & Network Administration Lead
Description:
**Who we are**

At Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we believe education is more than the pursuit of knowledge – it is a catalyst for transformation. Our mission, grounded in democratizing education, is to create access for learners from every background and empower them to achieve their aspirations and advance their careers.

We are committed to delivering rigorous, flexible programs that are both personally fulfilling and professionally rewarding, while contributing to the betterment of society. Since 2004, Yorkville has been among Canada’s few private, for-profit, fully accredited degree-granting universities, with campuses in Ontario, British Columbia, and New Brunswick. Together with Toronto Film School, we offer creative and academic pathways at both the college and university levels, cultivating a multidisciplinary environment where innovation and the arts converge.

Our community is vibrant and diverse. Many of our learners are adults balancing education with careers and personal commitments. Every member of our team – whether in teaching, operations, or technology – is dedicated to removing barriers and expanding access. Together, we deliver flexible, industry-informed learning that leads to meaningful opportunities.

At our core is human connection – guiding people to reimagine their futures in a community defined by opportunity, creativity, and growth.

**Who we need**

Reporting to the Director IT Security and Infrastructure we are hiring an System & Network Administration Lead to join our IT Operations team. As our new System & Network Administration Lead, you will lead the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and evolution of our cloud and on-premises infrastructure across a multi-site environment. You will take hands-on ownership of Azure, Microsoft 365, Windows Server and virtual machines, network infrastructure, firewalls, and infrastructure automation, ensuring our systems are reliable, secure, scalable, and performing effectively. Working closely with IT Operations, Network, Security, and external partners, you will lead infrastructure upgrades and improvements, strengthen operational practices, and act as the senior escalation point for complex infrastructure issues.

*This is an existing full-time role, working 2 days remotely and 3 days on-site at 85 Richmond Street West, with a move to our new headquarters at 120 Bloor Street East in Fall 2026.*

**What's in it for you**

*Ownership and impact.*
You will take meaningful ownership of the infrastructure that supports a growing, multi-site organization, working across Azure, Microsoft 365, servers, virtualization, networking, and security. This is an opportunity to strengthen how core infrastructure is managed, introduce greater consistency and automation, and directly influence the reliability, performance, and security of the technology environment.

*Technical breadth and modernization.*
You will work across cloud and on-premises technologies, giving you the opportunity to solve complex infrastructure challenges rather than being limited to one area. You will deepen your expertise across Azure, Microsoft 365, PowerShell automation, Windows Server, virtualization, firewalls, and networking while contributing to upgrades, migrations, infrastructure improvements, and emerging technology initiatives.

*Growth and leadership.*
You will join an IT Operations team where you can expand both your technical influence and leadership capabilities. As the infrastructure environment and team practices continue to evolve, you will have opportunities to lead projects, mentor technical team members, strengthen operational practices, and take on broader ownership.

**As our new System & Network Administration Lead, you will:**

* **Manage cloud and Microsoft environments.**
  You will manage, maintain, and optimize Azure infrastructure and Microsoft 365 environments, including Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID, and OneDrive. You will apply industry best practices and security standards to strengthen performance, reliability, and scalability.
* **Automate and improve.**
  You will develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate Azure infrastructure management, deployments, configuration, and routine operational tasks. You will identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and strengthen infrastructure practices.
* **Maintain and modernize infrastructure.**
  You will plan and execute Windows Server and virtual machine upgrades, migrations, patching, and ongoing maintenance across cloud and on-premises environments. You will monitor performance, proactively identify issues, and help ensure systems remain available, secure, and effective as needs evolve.
* **Strengthen network operations.**
  You will configure, maintain, troubleshoot, and upgrade network infrastructure, including Azure and Enterprise Grade Network Equipment, VLANs, LAN/WAN environments, VPNs, and wireless systems. You will work closely with the IT Security team to apply hardening standards, address vulnerabilities, and ensure infrastructure deployments are appropriately secured.
* **Lead infrastructure projects and support.**
  You will lead and coordinate infrastructure upgrades, migrations, deployments, and other technical initiatives, working across IT teams, business units, and external vendors. You will also provide hands-on L2/L3 operational support and act as a senior escalation point for complex infrastructure issues.
* **Strengthen operational practices.**
  You will apply ITIL practices across incident, problem, and change management and contribute to the continuous improvement of infrastructure operations. You will provide technical scoping and cost estimates to support capital and operating budget planning and help bring greater structure and consistency to how infrastructure is managed.
* **Provide technical leadership.**
  You will share your expertise with technical team members, provide guidance on complex infrastructure challenges, and help strengthen capabilities across the team. You will build collaborative relationships across IT and the broader organization to ensure infrastructure services continue to meet operational needs.

**You have:**

* **The infrastructure experience.**
  You have hands-on experience managing and supporting complex cloud and on-premises infrastructure, ideally within a multi-site environment. You are comfortable taking ownership of critical systems, troubleshooting complex issues, and supporting infrastructure through upgrades, migrations, and ongoing operational improvements.
* **The Microsoft expertise.**
  You have strong practical experience with Azure and Microsoft 365 environments, including Windows Server, virtual machines, Entra ID, Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, and OneDrive. You can use PowerShell to automate infrastructure management, configuration, deployments, and recurring operational tasks.
* **The networking and security knowledge.**
  You have experience configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise network infrastructure, including firewalls, switches, VLANs, LAN/WAN environments, VPNs, and wireless systems. Experience Enterprise Grade Network Equipment is valuable. You understand cybersecurity best practices and can partner effectively with Security teams to strengthen infrastructure and address vulnerabilities.
* **The operational mindset.**
  You understand ITIL practices and how they apply to incident, problem, and change management. You bring a proactive approach to monitoring infrastructure, identifying risks, resolving issues, and improving the reliability, performance, and consistency of IT operations.
* **The leadership and communication skills.**
  You can lead technical initiatives, provide guidance and mentorship to colleagues, and act as a trusted escalation point when complex issues arise. You communicate technical information clearly and can build productive relationships with IT teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and external partners.
* **The certifications.**
  Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Fortinet Network Security Expert (NSE), and ITIL certifications are assets rather than requirements.

**Why work at Yorkville University?**

At Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we are united by a shared purpose: placing the student experience at the heart of everything we do. Whether you are teaching, designing curriculum, advising learners, advancing technology, or supporting operations, your work directly fuels learning potential, strengthens inclusive communities, and fosters purposeful curiosity.

Here, professional growth is part of our culture. In your role, you will have opportunities to help the launch of career-relevant programs, expand your expertise, and access tuition-free courses across our institutions - from certificates to master’s degrees. Curiosity, initiative, and innovation are encouraged, and your ideas can move from vision to reality.

Our scale offers the best of both worlds: the reach and stability of a national institution combined with the agility of a mid-sized organization, where contributions are visible and valued. You will be part of a diverse and inclusive community where authenticity is celebrated, collaboration is expected, and impact is shared - on learners, colleagues, and your own professional journey.

At Yorkville and Toronto Film School, your work does more than make a difference. It empowers others to achieve their potential, while giving you the opportunity to realize yours.

**Compensation philosophy**

At Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we believe compensation should be fair, straightforward, and supportive of your growth. Our salary ranges reflect progression from learning in the role to excelling, with each offer based on skills, experience, and role complexity.

This position offers a minimum annual salary of $90,000 a midpoint of $100,000, and a maximum of $110,000. Established hires typically start near the midpoint, while the upper range is reserved for those with deep expertise and sustained contributions. Offers below the midpoint recognize strong potential with room to grow.

We strive for equitable, consistent pay, though rates may vary within the same role based on performance, specialized knowledge, and impact.

We welcome conversations about compensation throughout the hiring process.

**Join us**

We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have 70% of the qualifications we seek, express your interest.

**What you can expect from our hiring process:**

* A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
* An in-person interview with the Hiring Manager and a cross-functional team member, focused on your technical skills, hands-on infrastructure experience, problem-solving approach, and ability to work effectively in an evolving operational environment.
* A final interview with the CIO and a member of the Director, People HQ, focused on your technical experience, overall alignment with the organization, and working style.

Diversity, equity and inclusion are a critical component of life at Yorkville University and Toronto Film School and we are committed to making these values an integral part of our culture. We encourage applications from all qualified applicants, including women, persons with disabilities, Black, Indigenous and People of Colour (BIPOC), people from the Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Transsexual, Queer, Questioning, Two-Spirit, Intersex, Asexual + (LGBTQ2SIA+) community and other equity-seeking groups.

Yorkville University is committed to providing accessible employment practices that are in compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act ('AODA'). If you require accommodation for disability, please notify Human Resources at 1-877-429-4029.

Title: Lead ICT Engineer - Data Centers
Description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Lead ICT Engineer is responsible for leading the Information and Communications Technology engineering scope of Digital EPC projects from concept and detailed design through procurement, construction, systems integration, testing, commissioning and final handover. The role ensures that ICT infrastructure, telecommunications systems, data-centre connectivity, structured cabling, active networks, wireless solutions and unified communications platforms are secure, resilient, scalable and aligned with project and operational requirements.

The position provides discipline leadership for data centres, ICT facilities, telecommunications hubs, smart buildings, command-and-control centres and other technology-intensive developments. The Lead ICT Engineer coordinates engineers, designers, specialist consultants, OEMs, vendors, construction teams, systems integrators and client representatives while managing interfaces with power, cooling, ELV, security, BMS, DCIM and commissioning functions.

The role safeguards engineering quality and connectivity resilience through disciplined architecture governance, capacity planning, cybersecurity integration, equipment specification, vendor review, configuration control and change management. It resolves complex technical issues and ensures that ICT systems support integrated testing, operational readiness, business continuity and long-term maintainability.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. ICT Engineering Leadership**

Lead planning, execution and technical assurance of the ICT engineering scope, establishing architecture principles, delivery priorities, resource requirements, design schedules and quality expectations.

**2. ICT Infrastructure Architecture**

Develop and govern end-to-end ICT architecture covering data networks, structured cabling, telecommunications, wireless connectivity, data-centre infrastructure and unified communications.

**3. Network & Connectivity Engineering**

Lead design of LAN, WAN, WLAN, fiber-optic backbones, campus networks, internet connectivity and mission-critical communications, ensuring capacity, redundancy, availability and scalability.

**4. Structured Cabling & Passive Infrastructure**

Direct design and coordination of copper and fiber structured cabling, pathways, containment, equipment rooms, racks, cabinets, patching, labeling, testing and certification requirements.

**5. Telecommunications & Unified Communications**

Provide technical leadership for IP telephony, unified communications, video collaboration, operational communications and associated telecom infrastructure and interfaces.

**6. Cybersecurity & Network Resilience Integration**

Embed segmentation, secure architecture, access control, redundancy, monitoring, hardening and cybersecurity requirements into ICT designs in coordination with relevant stakeholders.

**7. Vendor & Procurement Engineering**

Prepare and review specifications, datasheets, requisitions, technical bid evaluations, vendor documents, deviations and clarifications for ICT equipment, software, licensing and services.

**8. Multidiscipline & Systems Integration Coordination**

Manage interfaces with ELV, security, audiovisual, BMS, DCIM, power, cooling, civil, architectural, construction and commissioning disciplines to deliver integrated solutions.

**9. Construction, Testing & Commissioning Support**

Resolve technical queries and field issues and lead readiness for factory and site testing, cable certification, network validation, failover testing, integrated systems testing and defect closure.

**10. Documentation, Handover & Team Development**

Ensure completion of configurations, asset records, as-built drawings, test evidence, operating manuals, training and handover documentation while guiding ICT engineers and designers

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE**

**ICT Engineering Experience: Minimum 12+ years in design and project delivery**

Progressive experience in ICT networks, telecommunications, structured cabling and digital infrastructure for data centres, smart buildings, transport, utilities or technology-intensive EPC projects.

**Discipline Leadership Experience: Minimum 5+ years leading ICT engineering teams**

Demonstrated responsibility for architecture, technical deliverables, equipment packages, vendor coordination, multidisciplinary interfaces, systems integration and engineering quality.

**Digital EPC & Commissioning Experience: Minimum 5+ years across procurement, construction and testing**

Experience translating ICT requirements into vendor packages, installation deliverables, configurations, testing procedures and operational-handover solutions.

**KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS**

**1. Enterprise Network Architecture**

Advanced knowledge of LAN, WAN, WLAN, routing, switching, network segmentation, redundancy, availability and capacity planning for complex digital environments.

**2. Structured Cabling & Data-Centre Connectivity**

Strong understanding of copper and fiber cabling, pathways, spaces, racks, cabinets, patching, labeling, testing, certification and data-centre connectivity principles.

**3. Telecommunications & Unified Communications**

Knowledge of IP telephony, unified communications, video collaboration, operational communications and related infrastructure, protocols and integration requirements.

**4. Cybersecurity, Configuration & Systems Integration**

Ability to incorporate secure architecture, access controls, monitoring, configuration management and interfaces with ELV, BMS, DCIM, security and operational systems.

**5. Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

Strong analytical, communication and decision-making capability to resolve complex ICT issues, lead technical teams and align clients, consultants, OEMs and integrators.

**EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS**

• Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related discipline

• Professional Engineering registration, chartered status, or equivalent professional qualification preferred

• Relevant advanced networking certification such as Cisco CCNP/CCIE, Juniper JNCIP/JNCIE, or equivalent strongly preferred

• Relevant certification in structured cabling, data centres, wireless, unified communications, cybersecurity, or project management advantageous

• Training in applicable international ICT standards, systems integration, HSE, or quality management preferred

**TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES**

**Enterprise Network Design:**

Designs and reviews resilient LAN, WAN, WLAN, routing, switching, segmentation, addressing, capacity and high-availability architectures.

**Structured Cabling & Fiber Infrastructure:**

Leads design and verification of copper and fiber systems, containment, equipment rooms, racks, labeling, testing and certification.

**Telecommunications & Unified Communications:**

Engineers IP telephony, collaboration, video, operational communications and associated platform and connectivity requirements.

**Cybersecurity & Configuration Governance:**

Applies secure architecture, access control, hardening, monitoring, configuration, change and technical-documentation controls throughout delivery.

**Testing, Commissioning & Systems Integration:**

Develops and governs test plans, network validation, failover testing, integrated systems testing, defect resolution and operational acceptance.

Title: Network Operations Manager
Description:
**About Us**
Effortless Office partners with our customers to make IT effortless so they can focus on their business. As a Hybrid Managed Services Provider (MSP) with a focus on providing world-class customer experience, we deliver and fully support secure cloud solutions as well as comprehensive managed IT and network services.
  
  
**About The Role**
Effortless is looking for a Network Operations Manager who is an excellent leader and engineer. This is a player-coach role: you will lead our network engineering team while remaining one of the company's top escalation and design resources for enterprise, high-availability, multi-platform networks.
  
  
You will own the health, security, and continuous improvement of the networks we manage for our customers and within our own Switch data center infrastructure. We expect you to be proactive: you will not wait for tickets. You and your team will regularly review client environments, find risk, capacity, and performance gaps before they become outages, and bring clear, cost-effective recommendations to our customers and Service Delivery Teams.
  
  
The ideal candidate has served as a Senior Network Engineer, has the technical depth to earn the respect of senior engineers, and has the leadership skills to develop them. You set a high standard, communicate clearly, take ownership, and care about the customer experience.
  
  
**Position Details**
**Reports to:**
President
  
  
**Direct reports:**
Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers
  
  
**Location:**
Remote with a preference for someone in/near Las Vegas, NV.
  
  
**Travel:**
Some travel required for data center work, client site visits, and special projects.
  
  
**Schedule:**
Monday - Friday 8:00-5:00 PST, with 24/7 escalation availability for major incidents and management of the team's on-call rotation.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401K + employer match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Opportunities for career growth and development
* Training and certification support

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Serves as the company's senior network engineering authority and final escalation point in core routing and switching, network security, and network diagnostics.
* Designs, reviews, and approves complex network configurations and architecture, including hardware and software technology, site locations, business continuity, disaster recovery, and integration of technologies.
* Personally assesses and resolves the most complex data network problems and incidents, and leads major incident response through to resolution and root cause analysis.
* Owns the design, standards, and lifecycle of Effortless's own network infrastructure at our Switch data centers, including Cisco Nexus, Firepower, and SDWAN (Meraki and Cisco Viptela) environments.
* Sets and maintains network engineering standards, configuration baselines, and documentation requirements in IT Glue, and reviews the team's work for quality and consistency.
* Reviews analyses and technical feasibility to develop data network deployment strategies, resource requirements, and cost estimates.

Proactive Client Improvement
  
  

* Leads a regular program of proactive network reviews across client environments to find security, reliability, capacity, and performance gaps before they cause issues.
* Uses Auvik monitoring, ticket trends in Autotask, and assessment data to identify recurring problems and drive permanent fixes rather than repeated reactive work.
* Assesses data network growth forecasts and ensures business needs are translated into network capacity requirements.
* Partners with Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, and ESAs to turn findings into clear, cost-effective recommendations for each client's technology roadmap.
* Tracks hardware and firmware end-of-life, vulnerabilities, and configuration drift across managed networks and plans remediation.
* Brings the customer's perspective to every recommendation: leads with business outcomes, not technology features.

Leadership
  
  

* Hires, onboards, coaches, and develops Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers, including technical mentoring and certification planning.
* Sets clear expectations, holds regular 1-on-1s, conducts performance reviews, and holds the team accountable using EOS tools (Rocks, Scorecards, Issues, To-Dos) in Strety.
* Manages team workload, project priorities, and resource availability, and plans and coordinates cross-functional or cross-company work.
* Owns network change management: reviews and approves changes, maintenance windows, and rollback plans.
* Manages the team's 24/7 on-call rotation and escalation process, and ensures after-hours coverage meets Effortless's service standards.
* Communicates status, risk, and outcomes clearly to leadership, Service Delivery Teams, and customers, following our CWC (Communicate, Work, Communicate) value.

Operations and Compliance
  
  

* Defines, tracks, and reports on network operations KPIs (see Success Measures below).
* Manages relationships with network vendors and carriers, including escalations, and supports procurement and licensing decisions.
* Ensures all compliance aspects of the position and team are known and followed; understands and complies with all policies, codes, and regulations applicable to the position and company, including client HIPAA, PCI, and NIST requirements.
* Maintains sensitive and confidential information regarding company and customer information.
* Performs related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
Education and Work Experience
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, or a related technical field
* 10+ years of experience with Service Provider, MSP, or enterprise networking or general telecommunications
* 3+ years in a Senior Network Engineer (or equivalent) role, serving as the top escalation and design resource for complex networks (required)
* 2+ years leading engineers as a manager, team lead, or technical lead, with direct responsibility for work assignment and mentoring
* MSP or multi-client environment experience strongly preferred

Specialized Knowledge and Skills

The Data Center Network Service Delivery Manager is a designated Key Personnel leader holding overall accountability for the design, architecture, operations, security, and performance of enterprise data center network services under the customer's Data Center Services (DCS) program. Operating across the customer data center hubs, this role ensures fault-tolerant network failover paths, high bandwidth, Software-Defined Networking (SDN) fabric management, port aggregation, multi-factor token-based remote access solutions, and rigorous intrusion detection and prevention compliance.

**LAN Support Services & Network Operations**

**Software-Defined Networking (SDN) & Policy Management**

* Continuously monitor and manage the enterprise Software-Defined Network (SDN) fabric across spine and leaf nodes, control planes, data planes, and multi-tenant endpoint groups.

* Install, configure, and operate centralized Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS), active blocking of malicious traffic, and real-time SIEM log integration with the Security Operations SCP.

**ITIL Governance, Monitoring & Multi-Vendor Collaboration**

* Enforce ITIL-aligned Incident, Problem, Change, Configuration, and Capacity Management processes in strict compliance with the Service Management Manual (SMM) and MSI tooling.
* Provide real-time monitoring and analytics for network capacity, bandwidth consumption, route utilization, and overall network health, automating event correlation and fault management.
* Coordinate cross-vendor Operating Agreements (OAs) and multi-supplier integrations with the MSI and peer SCPs, ensuring seamless end-to-end network delivery.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Experience: 7+ years of experience in enterprise network engineering and data center operations, with at least 3–5 years in a network service delivery management or technical leadership role (public-sector or state government experience strongly preferred).

* Technical Expertise: Deep technical command of Software-Defined Networking (SDN), data center routing/switching architectures, enterprise firewalls, load balancers, port aggregation, VPN/remote access gateways, and network monitoring/analytics tools.
* Service Management & Security: Strong working knowledge of ITIL service management frameworks, network security standards, and threat detection/IDS/IPS protocols.
* Security Clearance & Compliance: Ability to pass background checks meeting Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) security requirements and relevant state/federal compliance mandates.

Title: Senior Program Manager, Network Build
Description:
**Brief Description**
Senior Program Manager, Network Build
  
  
**HELP CONNECT ARIZONA. BUILD THE FUTURE OF BROADBAND**
.
  
  
At Wecom Fiber, we're helping bridge the digital divide across Arizona by building and maintaining the communications infrastructure that powers homes, businesses, schools, and communities. As our next Senior Manager of Field Operations Support, you'll play a key leadership role in scaling operations, improving performance, and helping shape the future of a rapidly growing telecommunications organization.
  
  
**WHY WECOM?**
At Wecom, we believe exceptional people deserve more than a paycheck.
  
  
We're building a workplace where employees can grow their careers, make an impact, and help shape the future of telecommunications across Arizona. Our employees are helping connect communities, expand broadband access, and bring meaningful technology infrastructure to underserved areas throughout the state.
  
  
**Department:**
Enterprise Program Management
  
  
**Reports to:**
Senior Director of Enterprise Program Management
  
  
**Location:**
Arizona – Statewide (Field/Hybrid)
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Senior Program Manager, Network Build leads the delivery of fiber network construction across one or more markets and the Design Areas within them. This role owns the plan for each market from an accepted design package through an operational network, and is accountable for keeping every Design Area moving through the same sixteen milestones, from package accepted to operational. The Senior Program Manager sets the standard for how the Network Build Program Managers plan, report and escalate, and is the primary voice of the build program to senior leaders. The role also helps build and refine the processes the team runs on, so that planning, handoffs, reporting and vendor payment become more consistent and more efficient as the program grows.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Plan and schedule ownership**

* Own the schedule and plan logic for assigned markets, including dependencies, crew capacity, quantities, production rates and weather effects, and keep them accurate as work moves from Project Controls to the Network Build team.
* Maintain the sixteen-milestone plan for every Design Area, and decide when a milestone is complete using evidence from the responsible team rather than assumption.
* Re-forecast dates when crew counts, weather, permits or materials change, and explain the effect on the market finish date.

**Milestone management and handoffs**

* Confirm the Operational state of each Design Area. The Senior Program Manager and the Network Build Program Managers confirm it; no other team does.
* Manage the release of each project to construction, including the handoff to Supply Chain for materials staging and the notice to Sales and Marketing.
* In Prescott, run the pre-construction approval sequence: Construction completes the utility locates and reports to the Program Manager, the Program Manager schedules the pre-construction walks, Design and Engineering makes comments and corrections, the City approves, and Construction is then released.

**Cross-functional leadership**

* Coordinate Design and Engineering, the Permit Specialist, Supply Chain, Construction, Sales and Marketing and the Network Operations Center so that each handoff is clean and dated.
* Hold a weekly meeting with each team on Thursday or Friday, collect final updates by Monday, and prepare the reports for the Wednesday 30-60-90 day review.
* Escalate risks, delays and decisions early, with a recommendation and the effect on schedule and cost.

**Vendor and financial oversight**

* Make sure construction vendors are paid accurately and on time by reviewing each submitted invoice against the approved design prints before it is entered for payment.
* Track budget against forecast for each Design Area and flag variances to leadership.

**Reporting and governance**

* Report status using four labels: On Track, At-Risk, Off-Track and Complete.
* Track grant-funded markets against their commitments and prepare the reporting those programs require.
* Review the plan data for accuracy each week, and correct gaps before reports are issued.
* Communicate directly with executives and senior leaders in writing and in meetings, presenting status, risks, decisions and recommendations in plain language with the conclusion first.

**Team leadership**

* Coach and review the work of the Network Build Program Managers, set consistent reporting standards, and step in on the most complex or at-risk markets.

**Process development and improvement**

* Help design and document the processes the Network Build team follows, including milestone definitions, handoffs between teams, schedule updates, reporting and vendor invoice review.
* Review how the processes work in practice each quarter, identify recurring delays, rework and gaps, and recommend and lead improvements.
* Turn lessons from completed Design Areas into updated standards, templates and checklists that every Network Build Program Manager uses.
* Work with Design and Engineering, Permitting, Supply Chain, Construction, Sales and Marketing and the Network Operations Center to agree on process changes before they are adopted.
* Train and coach the Network Build Program Managers on new and revised processes, and confirm that they are followed.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* A bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, business or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* At least eight years of program or project management experience, including at least five years delivering outside plant fiber, utility or telecommunications construction.
* Demonstrated ability to manage schedules with dependencies, crew capacity and weather, and to explain a forecast change in plain language.
* Experience managing construction vendors, including invoice review against design documents.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing and presenting executive-level status reports, briefings and recommendations that are clear, accurate and concise.

**Preferred**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent.
* Experience with federal or state broadband grant programs.
* Experience with permitting for rights-of-way, railroad, highway and utility pole attachments.
* Experience leading or mentoring other program managers.

What Success Looks Like

Title: Manager, IT Infrastructure Center of Excellence
Description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title:**
Manager, IT Infrastructure Center of Excellence
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Director, Information Technology Infrastructure & Services Delivery
  
  
**Business Unit / Function:**
Pr ocurement & Business Support
  
  
**Department:**
Information Technology
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
Lead infrastructure technical excellence through standards, solution design, and engineering across Maaden sites. Translate approved IT direction into reliable, scalable infrastructure and reusable capabilities. Enable IT Services Delivery to operate and support services effectively, while keeping day-to-day operations and enterprise strategy ownership with the accountable teams.
  
  
**What You Will Deliver**
Manage the infrastructure Center of Excellence for networks, systems, datacenters, and databases. Provide technical requirements, design assurance, engineering guidance and knowledge transfer, aligned with enterprise architecture and the Director’s approved priorities.
  
  
**Contract Strategy and Governance**
Develop infrastructure standards, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps within enterprise architecture principles. Define technical specifications and acceptance criteria for infrastructure solutions and sourcing. Govern technology selection, standard configurations, and lifecycle plans, including upgrades, refresh, and retirement. Assess emerging technologies for business fit, interoperability, capacity, and supportability. Recommend designs and exceptions through established architecture authorities; enterprise policy and strategy remain with the accountable leaders .
  
  
**Contract Administration and Compliance**
Maintain design documentation, configuration baselines, and engineering procedures. Govern and oversee infrastructure projects within delegated authority, coordinating with PMO and IT Services Delivery on scope, delivery plans, milestones, budgets, risks, dependencies, architecture and standards compliance, acceptance, and transition to operations. Review supplier deliverables against agreed specifications and standards. Coordinate design assurance, testing, and operational handover with IT Services Delivery, including support documentation and knowledge transfer. Verify that designs address integration, availability, capacity, recovery, and maintainability before transition. Document technical deviations and corrective actions and escalate non-compliance through the responsible governance and contract owners.
  
  
**Contractor Performance Management**
Assess suppliers’ technical deliverables and engineering quality against agreed requirements. Define and monitor infrastructure service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) in coordination with IT Services Delivery and relevant stakeholders; review performance against agreed targets, report deviations and drive corrective actions and continual design improvement. Use recurring-problem evidence from IT Services Delivery to inform engineering improvements. Develop infrastructure automation and DevOps engineering practices with delivery teams to improve repeatability and reduce manual work. Coach technical staff, share reusable designs and strengthen internal engineering capability. Daily operations, service support, and operational supplier SLA management remain with IT Services Delivery
  
  
**Commercial and Cost Management**
Develop capacity and lifecycle recommendations using utilization, availability, and technology requirements. Evaluate infrastructure options for standardization, reuse, and cost efficiency. Provide technical input to procurement, project estimates, and purchase requisitions within assigned responsibility; escalate funding and commercial decisions to the authorized owners. Manage and oversee infrastructure contracts, particularly the Infrastructure & Service Delivery managed service provider contract, within delegated authority and in coordination with Procurement, Legal, IT Services Delivery and relevant stakeholders. Validate technical scope, deliverables and SLAs/KPIs; oversee contractual compliance, performance reviews, escalations, corrective actions, changes, renewals, and exit/transition planning. Contract approvals remain with authorized signatories, and day-to-day operational ownership remains with IT Services Delivery.
  
  
**Risk, HSE and Business Continuity**
Define infrastructure resilience, backup and recovery design requirements with business continuity, security, and delivery teams. Support disaster recovery planning and testing; review technical findings and track engineering improvements. Apply relevant site HSE requirements during infrastructure work and escalate risks. Backup operations, incident response, and service restoration remain with IT Services Delivery.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
Infrastructure designs meet agreed standards and business requirements; documented handovers enable effective support. Roadmaps address capacity, lifecycle, and resilience needs. Technical assurance findings are resolved, or formally escalated, recurring issues inform engineering improvements, and delivery teams can reuse documented designs and procedures. Performance targets are agreed through the established management process.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or computer engineering. ITIL Foundation and ISO 20000-1 service management certification (preferred)
  
  
**Experience**
8–10 years of experience in IT service management, infrastructure, and end-user services, with practical technical requirements, infrastructure project, and standards experience. Good understanding of ITIL and ISO 20000 service management frameworks.
  
  
**Skills That Matter**
Infrastructure planning and technical documentation; analytical diagnosis and problem solving; emerging technology assessment; continuous improvement; stakeholder collaboration and communication; planning and prioritization; people leadership and capability development. Translate operational needs into clear technical specifications and explain design recommendations to technical and management audiences
